remarks:
WELCOME TO 65 PLEASANT VIEW - 
Step inside this charming 2 story cape cod and discover a home that offers a thoughtful floor plan complete with 4 total bedrooms, 2 full recently renovated bathrooms, and a living space fit for a variety of lifestyles! 
Enter the main level and enjoy the features of a comfortable living space, updated flooring, and a functional kitchen with opportunity. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom provide more space and connivence. This home also features central air, a smart thermostat, and a thoughtful layout of storage spaces. 
The details continue throughout, including a cedar closet in the upstairs bathroom, a basement equipped with a whole house generator installed in 2018 for added peace of mind, and a deck situated on a spacious open yard built for enjoying time outdoors.
With convenient access to Transit Road and nearby amenities, this home combines the character of a cape cod with practical updates and plenty of room to make it your own.
